title: feat(spec,plugin-auth): a demoStaff entry names its line manager, and os dev links it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCFW2vVVh9Bwz714cxX7PDq)_
Fixes #26616

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: #26764

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`demoStaff` 条目新增可选键 `manager`(填同一列表里另一条目的 email);`os dev` 启动时在所有演示账号建好之后、种子数据之前写入 `sys_user.manager_id`。
- 为什么改:新起的 demo 里每个账号都没有直属上级,审批流的 `manager` 一级找不到人,只能手工去 Setup → Users → Set Manager 补。
- 风险与回滚:只影响本地 `os dev` 启动且声明了 `manager` 的应用;已有上级(含手工改过的)一律不覆盖。回滚即 revert 本 PR,未声明 `manager` 的栈行为不变。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/demo-staff.ts` 的 `linkDemoStaffManagers`;`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `collectDemoStaffManagerErrors`;`packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` 的 `manager`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/demo-staff-provisioning.test.ts`,应见 11 个用例全绿(含 8、9 两个上级用例)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Spec (`packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts`).** A `demoStaff` entry gains one optional key, `manager`: the `email` of another entry of the same `demoStaff` list, compared without regard to case. A value that is not an address (the likely mistake: writing the manager's display name) is refused at the entry's path with a message saying it takes another entry's email. `reportsTo`, `managerEmail`, `managerId` (which also catches `manager_id`, one probe) and `supervisor` are aliases that point to `manager`.

**Why the email and not the name.** The address is the identity key on every path that provisions an account: the provisioning finds each entry's account by it (`findUserIdByEmail`), it is what makes a re-run idempotent, and the admin bulk import resolves its `manager_id` column by an identity key too, never a display name. A display name is a Tier-1 profile field the person can edit on their own profile, and it is the seed's reference key, not the account's. The schema already checks the address's shape, so a typo in it is caught at the entry before the stack check runs.

**Stack check (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, `collectDemoStaffManagerErrors`, called from `collectDemoStaffErrors`).** `defineStack` (and so `os validate` and every load) refuses, with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422, each of:
- a `manager` that is the address of no entry;
- an entry that names itself (case-insensitive);
- managers that form a loop, reported once per loop with every member and its `stack.demoStaff[i]` origin; an entry that only hangs from a loop is not named in it.

None of these is skipped: each would leave a manager link that the boot cannot write.

**Provisioning (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/demo-staff.ts`, the first reader).** `provisionDemoStaff` keeps its first pass unchanged and adds a second one, `linkDemoStaffManagers`, after every entry has had its turn and still on the same `kernel:ready`, so before the application seed. For each entry with a `manager`:
- no account for the entry: skipped, because the first pass already reported why it has none;
- no account for the manager: reported on `failed` under the subordinate's address, naming whether the manager's entry was not provisioned or is not an entry at all;
- the account's `manager_id` already equals the declared manager: nothing written;
- the account already has a different manager: left as it is and listed on the new `managersKept` (an `info` line on the boot log names them);
- no manager: written through `applyUserManagerLink`, the one derivation behind `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager`. Its refusals (self, cycle, depth, cross-organization, directory-owned) apply unchanged and are reported with their `code` and `reason`; this module carries no copy of them.

`DemoStaffOutcome` gains `managersLinked` and `managersKept`. `auth-plugin.ts` adds both to the boot's summary lines.

**A re-run never overwrites a manager set by hand.** The declaration wins only over absence. A manager that an operator cleared by hand reads as no manager, so the next boot writes the declared one again; the alternative (remembering which links the boot wrote) needs state outside `sys_user` that nothing else reads, for the one case where an operator wants a demo account to have no manager at all and also kept `manager` in the stack.

**Reference docs.** `content/docs/references/system/demo-staff.mdx` regenerated (`gen:docs`), `authorable-surface/system.json` gains `system/DemoStaff:manager`.

## Why

A fresh demo's approval ladder starts at the requester's manager, and `manager_id` was NULL on every demo account (measured in hotclm on 18.2.0: 11 of 11), so rung 1 reached nobody until someone set it by hand. Only the platform can write `manager_id`, so the application could not declare it.

## Tests

Runs through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Source as of `8e1dde389`; head `a516ef709` adds only the engine-double ledger line.

<details><summary>Spec: src/stack-demo-staff.test.ts (9 new cases) and the full suite</summary>

- New `describe('manager — …')`: accepts a manager declared after the entry, case-insensitively; accepts a three-link chain that reaches a top; refuses a display name at `demoStaff.0.manager` with the message; refuses `reportsTo` / `managerEmail` naming `manager`; refuses a manager naming no entry (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422 + first sentence); refuses self-reference (case-insensitive); refuses a two-entry loop once, naming both; refuses a three-entry loop that a fourth entry hangs from, naming only the loop.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` on `8e1dde389`'s parent tree: `Test Files 1 failed | 730 passed (731)`, `Tests 1 failed | 21928 passed | 1 todo`. The one failure was `src/shared/alias-integrity.test.ts`: my `managerId` and `manager_id` aliases share the probe `managerid`. Fixed by dropping `manager_id` (commit `8e1dde389`); re-run of `alias-integrity.test.ts` + `stack-demo-staff.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 42 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>plugin-auth: unit and real-boot pins, and the full suite</summary>

- `src/demo-staff.test.ts`, new `describe('provisioning — each declared manager is linked …')`, 6 cases on an engine double that records every update: fresh (the manager declared after the entry is linked, one `manager_id` update); re-run with the link in place (no update); re-run with a manager set by hand (no update, `managersKept: ['counsel1@legal.example']`); re-run after a manager was cleared (written again); the manager's entry not provisioned (reported on the subordinate, exact message, no update); the set-manager write refusing (`[PERMISSION_DENIED, idp_provisioned]`, no update).
- `src/demo-staff-provisioning.test.ts` (real `ObjectKernel`, ObjectQL on in-memory SQLite, real `AuthPlugin` + `SecurityPlugin`), new cases 8 and 9: a fresh boot leaves `manager_id` set for both orders of declaration (`managersLinked: 2`); the next boot keeps a manager re-pointed by hand and re-writes a cleared one (`managersLinked: 1`, `managersKept: ['para1@legal.example']`, no `warn`). `Test Files 1 passed`, `Tests 11 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 198 passed (198)`, `Tests 3788 passed | 10 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (after building plugin-auth's own dist, which `examples/basic-usage.ts` imports): exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the behaviour the card asks to keep)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/demo-staff.ts --anchor "      if (current !== null) {" --replacement "      if (current !== null && false) {" -- … vitest run src/demo-staff.test.ts`: anchor x1 → x0, blob `5ed3b373be04` → `7c15b3750852`; `× a re-run leaves a manager set by hand as it is, and says so`, `Tests 1 failed | 19 passed`; restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./demo-staff.js` from `src`, so no rebuild was needed for the mutation to reach it.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **No example app declares `demoStaff`.** `git grep -c demoStaff -- examples` answers 0 files on `8e1dde389` (control: `git grep -l "positions:" -- examples` answers 9), so no example is pinned. The consumers are hotclm (objectstack-ai/hotclm#28 and its PR objectstack-ai/hotclm#171, whose README keeps the manual Set Manager step for this alone) and HotCRM's sales managers.
- **The manager resolves within the list one `defineStack` sees.** `demoStaff` is refused inside `packages[].manifest`, so the list is the stack's own top level. Under `composeStacks`, each input was already `defineStack`-ed, so an entry naming a manager that only another publisher declares is refused at its own stack. The card asks for the same list, and nothing composes demo staff across publishers today.
- **The 20-link depth cap does not bound a declared chain.** `MAX_MANAGER_CHAIN_DEPTH` lives in plugin-auth, outside `packages/spec`, so the load-time check counts no links. At the boot the set-manager write walks upward from the proposed manager only: declared top-first, the link that crosses 20 is refused and reported on the subordinate; declared subordinate-first, each link is written while the chain above it is still short, and a longer chain lands.
- **Attribution.** At boot there is no request, so `authSystemWriteContext()` answers `{ isSystem: true }` with no `attributedUserId`; the write is a system write, as the account creation itself is.
- **Skills-docs.** `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (ceiling 5997 tokens) and `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` (ceiling 1469) sit at zero headroom in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, and raising a ceiling is not this card's call, so the teaching line (`manager` names another entry's email; `os dev` links it and never overwrites one set by hand) and an eval case are owed as a follow-up. The reference page is regenerated here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived local gates: 120 of 120 run, all exit 0 (dispatch-gates --ran reconciled)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 112 families on `8e1dde389`; run serially with no build in flight: 103 exit 0, 7 exit 3 (prerequisite: `packages/spec/dist` was older than the last source edit, plus the two whole-repo built-output gates), 2 exit 1:
  - `check:engine-double-contract`: `demo-staff.test.ts now pins 2 engine double(s), ledger records 1` (coverage grew). Fixed with `--write`, committed in `a516ef709`.
  - `spec check:generated`: `api-surface/` stale against the stale dist. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, it is green with no regenerated file.
- After rebuilding spec, the nine non-green ones were re-run: all exit 0 (`check:engine-double-contract`, `spec check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`).
- The ledger commit `a516ef709` added 8 families to the derivation (`check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`, `check:pnpm-flag-spellings`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`): all run, all exit 0.
- Final: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 120 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Not run locally, declared to CI: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` (no test in that project changed) and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the seven changed source files exits 0 (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
